acceptance_predicates.description: Only compatible catalog-pinned system or prebuilt artifacts can be reused/acquired and recorded.
Official retrieval enforces source, size, timeout, digest, declared proof, archive, entrypoint, and license checks before publication.
Verified executable artifacts are atomically installed project-locally with a complete receipt and failed updates retain a usable prior installation.
Wrong platform, unavailable/offline source, mismatch, revoked proof, archive traversal, unsafe executable, and partial transfer fail closed distinctly.

definition_of_done: Deterministic compatible-binary and official-prebuilt fixtures plus hostile negatives pass.
Independent review and exact-head/exact-main evidence pass.

inputs.description: AR-1776 official pinned source and verifier catalog.

gates.description: Positive verified reuse/retrieval and hostile artifact matrix pass.
Atomicity, prior-version retention, receipt, privacy, and project-root confinement pass.
